programme.desc: 'S20/E4 - The Five-Generation Pick'. Mike visits a time-capsule drugstore in Indiana, and Robbie and Jersey comb through a five-generation farmstead in West Virginia.

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: 'S20/E5 - The Mile-Long Yard Sale'. Mike and Jersey trip out over an Oddfellow's Lodge in Maryland, and visit one man's combination theme park, art installation and roadside attraction.

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: 'S20/E6 - Roadside Relics'. Mike uncovers a Godzilla-size stockpile of vintage movie posters, and Robbie pays up for a pair of ultra-rare Chevy signs for the shop in Tennessee.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S10/E13 - Beat The Judges: Test Of The Best'. For the first time in years, our top champions will step back into the arena, tasked with making the grueling Ginunting sword in just five hours, only one will be left standing.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S10/E14 - Beat The Judges: Machete Master'. Some of our top champions head back to the forge to face their toughest competition yet: one of the judges. Tasked with making a Vaquero Machete.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S10/E15 - Beat The Judges: Tackling The Tizona'. Two of our top Forged in Fire champions head back into our arena. Tasked with making the legendary Tizona of El Cid in eight hours.

programme.title: Hunting History With Steven Rinella
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - The Holy Grail Of Shipwrecks'. Steve investigates the mystery of Le Griffon, the legendary lost ship of the Great Lakes. Using his local knowledge and maritime expertise, he navigates shipwrecks and historical clues.

programme.title: Hunting History With Steven Rinella
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - First Humans Of North America'. On Prince of Wales Island lies evidence of one of humanity's greatest milestones. Steve investigates when the first Americans arrived and how they might have navigated and survived.

programme.title: Jesus: His Life
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Judas: The Betrayal'. What prompted one of Jesus' closest friends to turn on him? It remains one of the Bible's great mysteries, one explored as Jesus and his disciples enter Jerusalem for Passover and the Last Supper.

programme.title: Jesus: His Life
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Pilate: The Trial'. Pontius Pilate, the Roman governor of Judea, has to make a decision about a troublesome preacher called Jesus. As pressure builds to execute Jesus, Pilate's wife urges him to leave Jesus alone.

programme.title: Jesus: His Life
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Mary Magdalene: The Crucifixion'. With Jesus' mother, Mary witnesses the torment of the crucifixion from the foot of the cross. But her faith is rewarded the most when she is the first to witness the resurrection.

programme.title: Jesus: His Life
programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - Peter: The Resurrection'. A simple fisherman, Peter was Jesus' most devoted disciple. After Peter disavows Jesus during Jesus' arrest, the resurrected Jesus appears to Peter and restores him.

programme.title: Alone
programme.desc: 'S13/E1 - Before The Drop'. Meet the ten international survivalists of ALONE: World Championship at their final stop before the journey begins. In these last critical hours, they refine their strategies, lock in their gear.

programme.title: Repair Shop Australia
programme.desc: 'S1/E4'. A century ago, Melissa's great-grandfather was a miner in Cobar, his miner's chez lounge has passed down 4 generations of family and is now too shabby to be used. Melissa wants it out of storage and into her own lounge.

programme.title: Ultimate Mysteries
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Unidentified'. The Mantell UFO - do we now know what Captain Mantell saw before being killed? Has new scientific evidence been able to explain the UFO encounter in Levelland, Texas.

programme.title: We Are Not Alone
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. In episode 6, a psychiatrist in the United States discovers that prayer can attract Extra Terrestrial activity... shaking his religious beliefs.

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
programme.desc: 'S7/E7 - The Unabomber: Case Closed'. A twisted mastermind uses homemade bombs to terrorise the nation...Despite one of the most extensive manhunts in U.S. history, he still manages to stay one step ahead of law enforcement.

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Guadalcanal'. After the attack on Pearl Harbor, Japanese forces sweep across Southeast Asia. On Guadalcanal, United States Marines are given the bloody task of stopping their relentless advance.

programme.title: Isle of Man TT HL

programme.title: Supercar Showdown
